name: Hypernova Lens
tagline: Your Claude Code and Codex sessions on your glasses, with your computer in your bag
description: Hypernova on Even G2: look up to see your Claude Code and Codex sessions, one line each, the one that needs you on top. Hold the temple and speak to send a prompt, tap to allow a command, read a finished reply or have it read into your earbuds, and see a picture of what your agent built. Talks only to the Hypernova app on your phone, which connects to your own Mac or Linux server. Nothing goes through anyone else's server.
author: prudnik-web

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Connects only to the Hypernova app on this phone (127.0.0.1), which carries everything to your own computer.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: While you hold the temple, your voice goes through the Hypernova app on your phone to your own computer to become text. Nothing is recorded.

permissions.name: camera
permissions.desc: Takes one photo to scan a pairing code on your Mac or server. Nothing is stored.
